original_value: Fake news is risky, since it has been created to manipulate readers’ opinions and beliefs. In this work, we compared the language of false news to the real one of real news from an emotional perspective, considering a set of false information types (propaganda, hoax, clickbait, and satire) from social media and online news article sources. Our experiments showed that false information has different emotional patterns in each of its types, and emotions play a key role in deceiving the reader. Based on that, we proposed an LSTM neural network model that is emotionally infused to detect false news.

result.paraphrase: Fake news is dangerous because it is designed to manipulate readers’ beliefs and opinions. In this study, we examined the language of false news versus genuine news from an emotional standpoint, using several misinformation categories—propaganda, hoax, clickbait, and satire—from social media and online news sources. Our experiments found that each type of false information exhibits distinct emotional patterns, and that emotions are central to deceiving the reader. On this basis, we introduced an emotionally infused LSTM neural network model for detecting fake news.
